privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how Farm Assistant processes your information when you use our service. We are committed to transparency and data minimization. This service is operated by [YOUR NAME], [YOUR ADDRESS].
privacy.section_process_desc: We only process the information you directly provide or grant permission for:
privacy.process_chat: Chat text: The agricultural questions you type or speak into the chat interface.
privacy.process_photos: Leaf photos: The photos of affected plant leaves you upload or capture for disease identification.
privacy.process_location: Optional location: Your device coordinates (latitude and longitude) or the state and district you manually select to fetch local weather and mandi prices.
privacy.process_lang: Selected language: Your chosen interface language.
privacy.section_why_desc: We process this information solely and strictly to generate the farming answers, crop suggestions, disease checks, weather alerts, and mandi prices you request. We do not use your information for advertising, profiling, marketing, or any other secondary purpose.
privacy.section_storage_desc: The application has no database. We do not store chat texts, photos, or location data on our servers. Uploaded photos and questions are not written to server logs. Your conversation history exists solely within your active browser tab and is lost once you refresh or close the page.
privacy.section_thirdparty_desc: To deliver live agricultural data and AI assistance, certain requests are securely sent to trusted third-party providers. Each provider operates under its own privacy policy:
privacy.thirdparty_gemini: Google Gemini: Receives your chat text queries and compressed leaf photos to generate farming answers and disease diagnoses.
privacy.thirdparty_weather: Open-Meteo: Receives geographic coordinates to deliver local agricultural weather forecasts.
privacy.thirdparty_mandi: data.gov.in (Agmarknet): Receives selected state, district, and commodity names to retrieve official market prices.
privacy.section_browser_desc: We do not use tracking cookies, analytics identifiers, or advertising beacons. The only information saved on your device is your chosen language preference in your browser's localStorage, allowing the app to remember your language between visits.
privacy.section_rights_desc: Because we do not collect personal accounts or retain your queries and photos in a database, there are no persistent personal records to modify or delete. If you have any questions, concerns, or requests regarding this Privacy Policy, please contact:
privacy.contact_info: Name: [YOUR NAME] | Email: [YOUR EMAIL] | Address: [YOUR ADDRESS]
terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These Terms of Service govern your use of the Farm Assistant application. By using this service, you agree to these terms. Operated by [YOUR NAME], [YOUR ADDRESS].
terms.section_informational_desc: All farming advice, crop suggestions, disease diagnoses, weather notifications, and price records provided by Farm Assistant are for general informational and educational purposes only. They do not constitute certified agricultural consulting, scientific diagnosis, or professional agronomic recommendations. Always consult your local Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK), agricultural university, or certified extension officer for critical farming decisions.
terms.section_liability_desc: To the maximum extent permitted by applicable law, [YOUR NAME] and the creators of this application accept no liability for crop damage, crop loss, reduced agricultural yields, financial loss, or any incidental or consequential damages arising directly or indirectly from your reliance on information provided by this application.
terms.section_chemicals_desc: Farm Assistant strictly does not provide specific chemical pesticide, herbicide, or fertilizer dosages, application rates, or mixing ratios. You must always refer to the official manufacturer product label and consult your nearest Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK) or licensed dealer for authorized chemical applications.
terms.section_acceptable_desc: You agree to use this application only for lawful agricultural decision assistance. You must not abuse the service, attempt unauthorized automated scraping, upload malicious files, or interfere with the application's availability for other farmers.
terms.section_thirdparty_desc: Weather data is obtained from Open-Meteo, mandi prices from data.gov.in (Agmarknet), and AI responses from Google Gemini. Third-party data may be delayed, intermittent, or unavailable. We do not warrant the uninterrupted availability or absolute accuracy of external government or third-party feeds.
terms.section_governing_desc: These terms shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of India. Any disputes arising in connection with these terms shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the competent courts of India.
terms.section_changes_desc: We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time. Updated terms will be posted on this page with a revised effective date. Continued use of the application constitutes acceptance of any modified terms.
terms.section_contact_desc: If you have questions regarding these terms, please contact us at [YOUR EMAIL]. Contact: [YOUR NAME], [YOUR ADDRESS].
